samples.summaryVi: Gặp hàng xóm tạo hỗ trợ gần gũi; hoạt động nên tự nguyện và tôn trọng lịch, sự riêng tư.

paragraphs.label: Mở thư và mục đích
paragraphs.text:
Dear Ms Brown,

I am writing to invite you to a neighbours' coffee morning. We would be pleased to welcome you and believe that your participation would be valuable. The event will focus on getting to know neighbours.

paragraphs.text: The event will take place at the local library on Saturday at nine in the morning. During the session, participants will meet local residents and exchange practical information.
